info.title: Queue OpenAPI for fal-ai/ideogram/v2
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the fal-ai/ideogram/v2 queue.

x-fal-metadata.about: Ideogram's state-of-the-art image generation model. Can be used as an API directly from fal.

sync_mode.title: Sync Mode
sync_mode.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI and the output data won't be available in the request history.

negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt
negative_prompt.description: A negative prompt to avoid in the generated image

aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.description: The aspect ratio of the generated image

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Seed for the random number generator

expand_prompt.title: Expand Prompt
expand_prompt.description: Whether to expand the prompt with MagicPrompt functionality.

style.title: Style
style.description: The style of the generated image

prompt.title: Prompt
examples: A comic style illustration of a skeleton sitting on a toilet in a bathroom. The bathroom has a Halloween decoration with a pumpkin jack-o-lantern and bats flying around. There is a text above the skeleton that says "Just Waiting for Halloween with Ideogram 2.0 at fal.ai"

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Seed used for the random number generator

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
